visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A hand holds a brown Burger King paper bag in front of a man in a blue shirt sitting at a wooden table against a white wall. (2) Three men are seated at the table; the central man in a maroon shirt receives the bag while his friends in blue and green watch. (3) A close-up reveals a burger with two patties, melted cheese, and a thick, glossy red strawberry jam dripping over the edges onto a wrapper. (4) The men are shown eating the burger with exaggerated facial expressions, wide eyes, and pointing gestures to emphasize their reactions to the unusual combination. (5) The man in the middle uses a finger to playfully wipe red jam from the lips of the man on the right as they both laugh toward the camera. (6) The camera captures a cross-section of another burger showing lettuce, beef, and jam layers before cutting back to the three men laughing together in the studio-lit room.

(6) [Subtitle]: 真的是草莓果醬. 情人節真的要吃這個? 吃了會分手吧. (7) [Variety]: 好吃嗎? 我很喜歡欸. (8) [Subtitle]: 一開始會甜, 可是牛肉的鮮味跟它滿搭的啊. (9) [Subtitle]: 可是很奇怪啊. 醬汁那個煙燻味沒有被草莓蓋過去, 我覺得很棒欸. (10) [Subtitle]: 火烤就是美味. 我剛剛其實有偷吃一口, 我覺得還不錯. (11) [Subtitle]: 你已經結婚了, 你沒有辦法享受這種曖昧感. (12) [Variety]: 你的~嘴巴~. (13) [Variety]: 這就是草莓牛肉堡的真諦嗎!!!. (14) [Variety]: 難怪它醬要放這麼多!!. (15) [Variety]: 哇!!!. (16) [Subtitle]: 我是不是要離開.
